annotations.title: Chercher des annonces par photo / Find listings by photo

description: Find LISTINGS whose photo looks like a pet photo (https url or base64), to see if a lost or found animal was reported. To only identify a breed, use reconnaitre_race. Returns up to 10 listings with likeness %, dates and source, plus a breed estimate. Photo not stored. Accepts French or English; replies in French, or English with langue "en".

cible.description: Which listings to compare with: trouves (found or stray animals, default: for an owner who lost a pet), perdus (lost animals: for someone who found one) or tous (all). found and lost are accepted.

commune.description: French town name or 5-digit postcode (string, 2 to 80 characters), e.g. "Nemours", "77140" or "Chaumont 52" (department number to tell namesakes apart). France only; a place abroad returns no result.

espece.description: Species: chat (cat), chien (dog), oiseau (bird) or autre (other animal). cat or dog are accepted. Omit it and the species is inferred from the photo.

langue.description: Response language: "fr" (French, default) or "en" (English). A request written in English is answered in English even without it.

latitude.description: Latitude of the search centre in decimal degrees (number, -90 to 90), e.g. 48.267. Give it with longitude, instead of commune.

longitude.description: Longitude of the search centre in decimal degrees (number, -180 to 180), e.g. 2.693. Give it with latitude, instead of commune.

photo_base64.description: The photo encoded in base64 (string, with or without a data: header, about 2.5 MB at most), instead of photo_url; an image received in the conversation goes here.

photo_url.description: Public https address of the photo itself (string url; jpeg, png or webp, 8 MB at most), e.g. "https://example.com/cat.jpg". Give photo_url or photo_base64, not both.

rayon_km.description: Search radius in km around commune or the coordinates (number, 1 to 500, default 100 with a centre). Without a centre, all of France is searched.

name: chercher_par_photo

couleur.description: Listing colour, translated into the response language when it is in the colour vocabulary, otherwise as written.

criteres_demandes.description: For each criterion of the request (breed, colour, sex, age, gets-on-with), whether the record states it. Empty when no such criterion was asked.

precise.description: true when the record states this criterion (and matches it); false when it does not say, so it is kept as a possible match.

lieu.description: Written place, only when the position is not blurred.

mise_a_jour_le.description: Latest news of the listing (ISO date). In search results: the latest located sighting that moved it, otherwise its publication (same as derniere_nouvelle). voir_annonce also counts its last sighting and status change, so it can be later there.

publiee_le.description: When the record was first published (ISO date): on Mission Museaux, at the original platform for a reprise, or by the association offering the animal. null when unknown.

source.description: Where the record comes from: mission_museaux (published on Mission Museaux), reprise (a listing relayed from another platform, not named; contact goes through the original listing) or association_partenaire (an animal offered by another French association or shelter, not registered on Mission Museaux, whose listing Mission Museaux relays).

lieu_non_couvert.description: Present when the given town is not a French town: without a requested department, no search took place; Mission Museaux covers France.

raison.description: hors_france: a place abroad (Madrid, London); introuvable: no town of that name.

espece.description: The estimated or given species, in the response language; for a bird or another animal, races lists its kinds (budgerigar, rabbit…).

nom.description: The type in the response language (“herding dog”, “rodent”).

part.description: Combined share of this type's breeds, or kinds, among the top three, in %.

famille.description: The likely dog type when no breed dominates (verdict “incertain”) but the first two breeds, its examples, are of this type and its breeds among the top three gather more than half of the estimate; likewise, for a bird or another animal, the group of its first two kinds (rodent, parrot, tortoise…); null otherwise, and always for a cat.

page.description: The breed's page on the site; for a kind of bird or other animal, which has none, its Wikidata entry (for a wild bird, the association's advice).

title: Chercher des annonces par photo / Find listings by photo
